set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-owner.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Obtain only the remaining model/component licence and FilmFestival/other participant-corpus ethics decisions. Retain the recorded Sherlock disposition. Do not infer corpus admission or REB consent from host approval or pseudonymization.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Owner-only dispositions still open (governing: PLAN.md §6; B0 analysis in plan b12f79c §9.1, ratified 2026-08-30). Nobody accepts terms on the owner's behalf.
1. pyannote.audio: accept or decline the gated Hugging Face terms (needed only if diarization enters an AV evidence profile).
2. MF2 (NC-SA, research-only): include or exclude. It stays excluded from defaults until decided.
4. FilmFestival: participant-content and REB basis for the viewed film editions.
5. Any other human recall corpus: an owner-recorded REB and redistribution basis before recall bytes, prose, excerpts, provider logs or derived text enter git.
Resolved: item 3 (Sherlock; owner policy 2026-09-01: only raw video bytes are excluded).
Acceptance: a recorded decision note per open item. None of these gates the local annotation-assisted Sherlock preview.
